judged_text: Only evt.destinationCalendar[0] is connected to the Booking row, so the member destination calendars the PR collects for collective events are discarded from persisted state at save time. Every flow that rebuilds CalendarEvent from the stored booking (Stripe/PayPal handlePaymentSuccess, confirmHandler for requires-confirmation bookings) sees only the organizer's calendar, so paid or confirmation-gated collective bookings create calendar events on the organizer's calendar only — the multi-host fix silently does not apply to them.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, for collective events, appends team members’ destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` in `handleNewBooking.ts`). However, when persisting the Booking, only the first destination calendar is saved: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (same file, booking create/update payload). Since `booking.destinationCalendar` is still a singular relation (all later rebuilds use `booking.destinationCalendar` and wrap it into a 1-element array, e.g. Stripe/PayPal webhooks and `confirmHandler`), any deferred flows that reconstruct `CalendarEvent` from the stored Booking will only see that first (organizer) calendar and will not recreate events for the collected member calendars.
